messages.subject: Updating UnmarkedFit Objects with New Parameter Values
parts:
Hello unmarked group,

I was wondering if there is a straightforward way to update parameter estimates in an unmarkedFitPCount object with new values? Specifically, I derived new parameter SEs and confidence intervals for a model using a nonparametric bootstrap, and I want to use these new values when making predictions. I think(?) SEs are typically calculated retroactively with summary() and aren't stored in the Fit objects themselves, so there may not be an easy way to do this, but I figured I'd ask anyway. As always, thanks for the help!

Best,
Tyler
